rows.label: qst650312_msg0005
rows.name:
There've been more monsters around
here lately.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0006
rows.name:
I'm worried about the village's
safety, and it's making it hard to get
to the other islands.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0011
rows.name: Really? That'd be a big help.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0012
rows.name:
Defeat the Flow Bunnits around Rijite
Port.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0013
rows.name:
Then the Surumo Runners around Daram
Island.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0014
rows.name:
I'll ask too. Take down the Seigel
Ansel.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0015
rows.name:
They're causing trouble in the fields,
so please take care of the Buuma Hirun
around Iyasaki Village too.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0016
rows.name:
Me too. Please take down the Yureim
Shigaru.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0021
rows.name: I'd like some Three-Eyed Medaka too.

rows.label: qst650312_msg0023
rows.name:
But we're the only ones who can do it,
right?

rows.label: qst650312_msg0024
rows.name: Yeah. We'll just have to do our best.
